expectations.text: 输出格式是否严格是那三个键的一行 JSON
expectations.evidence: stats.mjs emits exactly `process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ lines, words, chars }) + '\n')` — one JSON line, no other stdout writes; Observed output in transcript turn 2: `{"lines":2,"words":4,"chars":20}` — exactly the three required keys lines/words/chars, matching the requested key order, no extra fields; Empty-file case output `{"lines":0,"words":0,"chars":0}` and Unicode case `{"lines":1,"words":2,"chars":6}` both show the same strict three-key single-line shape; Failure path writes nothing to stdout: error handler is a bare `catch { process.exit(1); }` with no logging; test observed `exit=1` with empty stdout; final_message documents the same format and the empty-stdout-on-failure behavior, consistent with the code
